fluidcompact.configuration.title: FluidCompact Configs
fluidcompact.configuration.fluids.toolti: Which fluids are drained from the world
jei.fluidcompact.finite_pump: With FluidCompact this pump no longer creates water. Every bit it pumps is removed from the water source blocks around it, so a small pond can run dry. Place it next to a large body of water such as an ocean or river and let the water flow back in.
fluidcompact.tab.mod_compact_list.toolti: Every mod FluidCompact works with. Turn modules off or lower their cost if your game lags.
fluidcompact.group.overview.desc: Status of every compatibility module in this game.
fluidcompact.group.mi.desc: Bronze, Steel and Electric Water Pump. These two values were already in fluidcompact-common.toml and keep working as before.
fluidcompact.group.mekanism.desc: Makes the Electric Pump really remove the source blocks it pumps.
fluidcompact.group.mekanism_elements.des: Makes the Seawater Pump drain the water source below it.
fluidcompact.group.fluidlogged.desc: Lets fluids enter and flow through pipes and cables. Changes need a game restart.
fluidcompact.option.enableFiniteFluids.d: Master switch of the core rules. Off = every machine behaves as without FluidCompact.
fluidcompact.option.backendPreference.de: Which system removes fluid from the world. AUTO prefers Flowing Fluids when it is installed.
fluidcompact.option.finiteWater.desc: Pumps drain water from the world instead of creating it.
fluidcompact.option.finiteLava.desc: Pumps drain lava from the world instead of creating it.
fluidcompact.option.finiteTaggedFluids.d: Also treat fluids in the tag fluidcompact:managed_fluids as finite.
fluidcompact.option.compatEnabled.desc: Master switch for every compat module. Turn it off if you suspect one of them causes lag.
fluidcompact.option.miDrainPercent.desc: World water consumed per unit pumped. 100 = one for one, 50 = twice as efficient.
fluidcompact.option.miMinTicks.desc: Minimum ticks between two drains of the same pump. Higher = slower pumps and less work. 0 = no limit.
Force the Electric Pump to remove source blocks.
fluidcompact.option.electricPumpWater.de: Apply to water (needs Finite Water in Core).
fluidcompact.option.electricPumpLava.des: Apply to lava (needs Finite Lava in Core).
fluidcompact.option.electricPumpTagged.d: Apply to fluids in the tag fluidcompact:managed_fluids.
fluidcompact.option.seawaterEnabled.desc: Make the Seawater Pump drain the water source below it.
fluidcompact.option.seawaterDrainPercent: World water consumed per unit of seawater made. 100 = one for one.
fluidcompact.option.seawaterMinTicks.des: Minimum ticks between two drains of the same pump. 0 = no limit.
fluidcompact.option.seawaterShortfall.de: SCALE_DOWN produces less seawater, STOP produces none for that cycle.
fluidcompact.option.fluidloggedEnabled.d: Register the FluidCompact addon in Fluidlogged. Needs a restart.
fluidcompact.option.fluidloggedFluidlogg: Pipes can contain fluid, so flowing water no longer destroys them.
fluidcompact.option.fluidloggedPermeable: Fluid passes through pipes instead of treating them as walls.
fluidcompact.option.fluidloggedShapeInde: Let fluid pass whatever the pipe shape is.
fluidcompact.option.fluidloggedBlockClas: Java class names of pipe-like blocks. Every block of these classes is covered.
fluidcompact.option.fluidloggedExtraBloc: Block ids like modid:block or block tags like #modid:tag to include as well.
fluidcompact.option.logFileEnabled.desc: Write logs/fluidcompact.log in the game folder.
fluidcompact.option.logVerbose.desc: Also log every fluid intake. Turn on for bug reports, off for normal play.
fluidcompact.option.logThrottle.desc: Minimum milliseconds between two verbose lines about the same machine.
jei.fluidcompact.compat_finite_pump: With FluidCompact this pump no longer creates fluid from nothing. Everything it pumps is removed from the source blocks it takes from, so a small pond can run dry.
fluidcompact.notice.unofficial: An unofficial intermediary compatibility mod that helps Flowing Fluids (by Traben, LGPL) understand other mods better. Flowing Fluids is required.
Teaches Flowing Fluids that pipes stay submerged instead of being drained and flickering. Uses the same pipe list as Fluidlogged.
fluidcompact.option.ffPipesEnabled.desc: Turn the whole pipe handling for Flowing Fluids on or off.
fluidcompact.option.ffPipesNonDisplacers: Registers pipes in Flowing Fluids as blocks that do not displace fluid, through its public API.
GLOBAL Flowing Fluids setting, also affects slabs and stairs. IGNORE (safe, default): pipes neither take nor give water, so they cannot duplicate it. KEEP_FLOWING_FLUIDS_SETTING changes nothing. Other modes are experimental and need the option below. Applied in memory when a world starts.
fluidcompact.option.logDebug.desc: Logs a full config dump, every loaded mod, every fluid intake without throttling and every pipe block update. Files get big, use it only for bug reports. Pipe tracing needs a restart.
fluidcompact.option.ffPipesAllowExperime: Lets the mode above use values other than IGNORE / KEEP. Water duplication through pipes was observed with them. Testing only.
fluidcompact.option.ffPipesCleanOrphan.d: Removes water left in a waterlogged pipe once no non-pipe neighbour holds water. Stops hanging water cubes and stuck water.
fluidcompact.option.ffPipesCleanupInterv: Ticks between cleanup passes. Higher = less lag, slower cleanup.
fluidcompact.option.ffPipesCleanupRadius: Only pipes within this many chunks of a player are cleaned. Lower = less lag.
